marta.name: Marta
marta.description: Marta keeps the Last Candle. She is broad, grey-braided and unhurried, and has the forearms of someone who has thrown out a great many drunks and enjoyed most of it.

greeting.text: "You opened the chapel." It isn't a question. She sets the tankard down very gently. "Then whatever's in there knows you're here. Go careful, love. I've already buried you once."
"That's Abel's key." Her mouth goes thin. "He said nobody was to open the chapel. Then again, he said nobody was to get off their pyre, either. Times change."

"You were dead," Marta says, not unkindly. "I closed your eyes myself. I'd thank you not to make a habit of it." She puts the tankard down. "The chapel's barred. Old Sexton Abel had the key, and Abel went into the ground last week, up in the graveyard east of the chapel steps. He kept something under that hill. If you mean to go poking at the chapel, that's where I'd start."
